summary: Gives guidelines for sending documents that follow the US Department of Defense standard MIL-STD-1840 through Internet email. It defines how that kind of data is labeled with a MIME content type. It is informational only.

eli5.summary: Some government paperwork came in a special format. This note explains how to tuck that paperwork into an email and label it so the receiver knows what it is.
